name: encrypted-wrong-credential
title: A wrong passphrase must be refused, and refuse to leak
description: Three wrong passphrases are offered to three distinct prompts. The pass condition is the refusal: repeated prompts appear, the boot target is never reached, no filesystem is mounted from the encrypted volume, and nothing sensitive lands on the console. Expressed directly — the refusal is required, the success is forbidden — so an empty log passes nothing.
